scope: Original English 2008 CE01 / original 50 / applicable base FAQ only. No Technology, variants, Anniversary, or expansion rules used.

case.reserve: One original Reserve legally plays a printed Attack 04 from hand using its power as a reinforcement; that card is later discarded.
case.wild_holder: A different player, not Reserve, already has Reserve Wild legally active for this encounter.
case.supplied_legality: First play, role, timing, and other prerequisites are supplied as legal; no additional flare eligibility facts inferred.

answer: The discarded printed Attack 04 cannot be taken by Reserve Wild. For this card-acquisition effect, the FAQ requires its original printed type, attack, rather than its reinforcement function in the encounter.
published_status: Derived application of explicit published general rules plus the published Reserve Wild clarification; no inspected source explicitly names the Reserve power + Reserve Wild pairing.
confidence: High for this specified conditional case. This is synthesis, not a claimed verbatim pairing ruling.

rules_chain.locator: Original Reserve native sheet, first power paragraph
rules_chain.rule: As a main player or ally, after encounter cards are revealed, Reserve may play one or more attack cards of 06 or less from hand as if they were reinforcement cards of their listed value.
rules_chain.application: Attack 04 is an attack card with a permitted reinforcement use. The power supplies play authority and encounter contribution, and does not say to change its printed identity or create an exception for collecting it from discard.

rules_chain.locator: 2008 rules p.13, Card Types / Reinforcement Cards / Flare Cards; extract lines 1022–1064
rules_chain.rule: Attack and reinforcement are distinct card types. Reinforcements add to encounter totals. Another alien normally uses a flare’s Wild effect.
rules_chain.application: This case uses one alien plus its Wild held by someone else. No duplicate Reserve alien is required.

rules_chain.locator: FAQ p.4, identity questions; extract lines 318–360, especially 332–341
rules_chain.rule: Unless otherwise specified, effects strictly affecting encounter resolution use current modified type/value; every other kind of effect uses original printed type/value. The surrounding question also says any effect targeting a card outside encounter totals targets its identity.
rules_chain.application: Reserve’s use of the card to affect the encounter total is on the current-function side of the distinction. A subsequent effect acquiring it into hand is on the printed-identity side.

rules_chain.rule: After one play of Reserve Wild, whenever another player discards a reinforcement for the rest of the encounter, the holder may take it and add it to hand.
rules_chain.application: Duration supplies repeated opportunities; it does not broaden the eligible card type. The specified discarded card is printed attack, not printed reinforcement.

rules_chain.locator: Original Reserve wording plus FAQ p.4 default and p.19 trigger
rules_chain.rule: Specific text can override a general rule, but only within what it specifies.
rules_chain.application: The phrase play ... as if they were reinforcement cards specifies a use in play, not a discard-acquisition identity exception. Thus the otherwise-specified exception is not supplied for this later trigger.

distinctions.use_event_category: Played by Reserve power as a reinforcement, rather than one of the two revealed encounter cards.
distinctions.current_type_for_strict_resolution: Functions as a reinforcement of listed value 04 for its permitted encounter contribution.
distinctions.discard_acquisition: Reserve Wild tests the eligible card for an effect that takes it into hand. This does not compute the encounter winner, compensation, rewards, or ship disposition.
distinctions.timing_is_not_classification: Being used during an encounter does not make every effect an effect strictly affecting encounter resolution. The FAQ explicitly defines that narrower category.

alternative_reading_assessed.proposal: Because Reserve played it as a reinforcement, another player later discards a reinforcement, so Reserve Wild could catch the event category.
alternative_reading_assessed.assessment: This reading is not supported as an exception by the inspected text. Wild’s wording refers to a reinforcement card; its published clarification provides duration and acquisition, without specifying previously-used-as-reinforcement eligibility. Extending Reserve’s play-as permission into this later card-acquisition test would bypass the FAQ’s explicit printed-type default.
alternative_reading_assessed.necessary_interpretive_step: Read play ... as if they were reinforcement cards according to its stated play scope, and apply the FAQ’s current-type versus printed-type default to the later acquisition effect. This is the general rule’s application, not an extra table ruling.

fido_control.published_rule: Fido cannot take Reserve power-use cards; Fido is restricted to the encounter cards actually played in that specific role.
fido_control.relevance: Confirms that printed card identity and use as a particular encounter card are separate questions. It is not a blanket rule that Reserve’s attacks cease being attack cards or automatically become eligible for Reserve Wild. Fido’s role restriction is not transferred to Wild.
